budget_items.what_was_said: The town notified the school committee of a new round of remaining ARPA funds available, with submissions due by the end of the month, prompting this meeting.

The original vendor quoted the whole building on backup power, but the district only needs the boiler room and kitchen covered; the original site visitor has since retired and a new site visit was requested, with a rough estimate given.

budget_items.topic: Primary school AC project phase two
budget_items.what_was_said: Beardmore said the select board is unlikely to fund the full ask given questions about green-communities rebate eligibility, but any partial funding for two more classrooms would help.

The original study only covered the hill down to the track, not drainage under the turf itself; the committee wants enough additional money to complete the assessment before committing to new turf, but does not yet have a firm number.
A vehicle request has been turned down two years running and Beardmore suggested it be raised again in next month's capital plan discussion.

budget_items.topic: Primary school driveway phase one assessment
budget_items.what_was_said: Last year's capital request for a driveway-expansion phase-one assessment came in below the funding threshold that would normally get select-board attention.
This was already funded using school lunch program funds rather than needing capital or ARPA money.

A hearing-aid-compatible audio loop for the library's community room, previously requested in capital planning, was recalled at roughly this cost and the committee asked to have it added to the auditorium booth quote.

minutes.headline: Committee skipped a vote, told the superintendent to submit turf-field drainage study and auditorium upgrades as its top ARPA asks
minutes.summary: The school committee spent most of this meeting deciding what to request from the town's remaining ARPA funds, reviewing a superintendent-prepared list of capital-type projects including a primary school generator, AC phase two, concession stand keycard access, auditorium booth upgrades, and a track/turf drainage study. Rather than vote, the committee reached consensus to prioritize the turf drainage study and the auditorium booth upgrades, drop the AC project from the list, and let the superintendent compile and submit the remainder for the select board's consideration. The committee also approved June 5 minutes, tabled two other sets of minutes pending corrections, and agreed to schedule an August meeting to act on the capital plan.

what_happened.line: The committee skipped a formal vote and instead directed the superintendent to submit its ARPA funding requests to the select board.
A turf and track drainage study and auditorium booth upgrades were set as the top two ARPA priorities.
A primary school air conditioning project was dropped from the list amid questions about rebate eligibility.
Two sets of prior meeting minutes were tabled pending corrections rather than approved.
The committee agreed to schedule an August meeting to vote on the capital plan before a September deadline.

why_it_matters: This shapes which capital projects -- drainage work, auditorium accessibility, HVAC -- get funded from the town's remaining ARPA money instead of a future town budget line.
No vote was taken here; the select board and a later School Committee vote still decide what actually gets funded.
